jobs.title: Vendor Strategy Manager - Cisco
jobs.description:
About the Role
In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing strategic market and product line business plans, analyzing market data, leading vendor quarterly business reviews, and acting as the business owner for assigned vendor technology or product line. You will be seen as the go-to person for supporting vendor strategies and go-to-market plans, as well as identifying volume and strategic customers, developing partnerships, and driving market growth. As a Strategic Business Manager, you will play a critical role in uncovering new business opportunities, refining growth plans, and implementing effective marketing strategies to build awareness and sales volume.

What You’ll Do
·       Develop and implement strategic market and product line business plans and programs to drive growth and achieve business objectives.
·       Analyze market data to identify trends, opportunities, and potential areas for business expansion; create comprehensive reports and presentations.
·       Lead vendor Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), fostering collaboration and alignment with vendors to drive mutual success.
·       Act as the business owner for assigned vendor technology or product line, taking responsibility for its performance, growth, and market positioning.
·       Serve as the go-to person for supporting vendor strategies and go-to-market plans, providing expertise and guidance to cross-functional teams.
·       Identify volume and strategic customers, establish and nurture partnerships to drive business growth and market penetration.
·       Create reports and deliver group presentations at vendor and customer sites, effectively communicating business insights, proposals, and solutions.
·       Proactively develop innovative approaches to uncovering new business opportunities, staying ahead of market trends and competitor activities.
·       Track progress against annual and quarterly plans, consistently monitoring and evaluating performance to achieve market growth and incremental sales.
·       Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for vendor technologies and programs, as well as market segment technologies.
·       Possess the ability to pivot quickly against the current strategy if proven ineffective, based on ROI and results.
·       Cross-market complementary solutions into appropriate vertical segments, maximizing revenue opportunities.
·       Refine growth plans on an ongoing basis, identifying ways to build margin through bundling, introducing third-party materials, etc.
·       Identify in-demand products within the assigned product line and develop effective marketing strategies to build awareness and increase sales volume.
·       Lead and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For
·       5 to 8 years of relevant work experience.
·       College Degree in Business, IT, or related field preferred.
·       Proficient in executing instructions and requesting clarification.
·       Basic data entry and mathematical skills.
·       Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
·       Detail-oriented with accuracy and efficiency.
·       Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
·       Ability to create and conduct formal presentations.
·       Comfortable interacting with high-level management.
·       Skilled negotiator, able to promote and sell ideas persuasively.
·       Strong leadership and organizational skills.
·       Adaptable to change and able to work under pressure.
·       Ability to maintain confidentiality and ethical standards.
·       Strong multitasking and collaborative abilities.
·       Proficient in advanced computer systems and applications.
·       Occasional non-standard work hours or overtime as needed.
·       Professional, hybrid office environment

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

We are seeking a curious, analytically rigorous Strategy Analyst to support the ideation, design, and activation of key organizational initiatives. While anchored in our people strategy, this role has a broad mandate that touches on operational excellence, enterprise-wide transformation, and broader business objectives.
Serving a dual mandate, the ideal candidate acts as both a strategic thought partner—helping translate ambiguous business challenges into actionable strategies—and functions in a "Chief of Staff" capacity to orchestrate the cadence of the organization. This is a high-visibility role for someone with an internal consulting mindset who thrives on conceptualizing solutions, managing complex portfolios, and turning ambiguity into structure.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Ideation & Problem Solving
Act as a thought partner to leadership to conceptualize and design new business and organizational strategies. Shift beyond just reporting by actively participating in the "whiteboarding" phase—identifying root causes, structuring complex problems, and proposing innovative solutions. Develop clear, executive-ready narratives and frameworks that communicate complex ideas and drive enterprise-level decision making. Thrive in a dynamic environment, bringing the same rigor and creativity whether the work is a quick-turn strategic pivot or a multi-month transformation initiative.

Chief of Staff Operations & Organizational Alignment
Serve as the central nervous system for the HR organization, keeping a pulse on the overarching portfolio of initiatives, managing operational cadence, and ensuring cross-functional alignment. Act as a connector across departments — facilitating conversations, managing dependencies, and keeping leadership informed on organizational health and project speed. Build and maintain strong working relationships across the enterprise, earning trust as a reliable and credible partner who can move forward without formal authority.

Data Analytics & Insight Generation
Gather, synthesize, and interpret qualitative and quantitative data to build the evidence base behind new strategies and operational efficiencies. Identify the right data sources, ask the right questions, and connect the dots across inputs to surface insights that drive financial and operational impact. Shape findings into clear, digestible narratives that bring the "so what" to life for senior business leaders.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree required, MBA or advanced degree preferred. 2–4 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, operational excellence, or a highly analytical business role (Exposure to enterprise transformation or people-focused projects is a plus) Strong analytical capabilities with advanced proficiency in Excel and data structuring; comfort working with ambiguous or incomplete data sets to build out populations, hierarchies, and systemic efficiencies. Strategic thinker with a demonstrated ability to ideate, solve problems, and produce polished, executive-quality materials. Clear and structured communication style—both written and verbal—with an instinct for what matters to senior audiences. High organizational acumen with a proactive, self-starting approach and the ability to manage multiple workstreams with limited oversight.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Treasury
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Treasury

About the Role
TD SYNNEX is seeking a Senior Director, Treasury to lead core treasury operations across cash, liquidity, debt, and foreign exchange. In this visible, impact-driven role, you will own daily cash positioning, short-term borrowing and investing, and cash flow forecasting while strengthening our global bank relationships and optimizing working capital. You’ll design and implement cash management strategies, evaluate technologies, and oversee risk management practices that safeguard our balance sheet and support growth. This role partners closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and business leaders to ensure resilient liquidity, disciplined risk management, and policy compliance.

What You’ll Do
- Lead day-to-day treasury operations, including cash positioning, short-term borrowing, and deployment of excess cash.
- Own cash flow forecasting and variance analysis; deliver timely, accurate liquidity reporting and insights to leadership.
- Manage and cultivate banking relationships; negotiate services and fees, drive service-level excellence, and oversee KYC and account administration.
- Oversee letters of credit, guarantees, and trade finance instruments; ensure timely issuance, renewals, and compliance.
- Assess and manage foreign exchange exposures; develop and execute hedging strategies aligned to policy; monitor hedge effectiveness.
- Oversee interest rate risk management, evaluate debt portfolio positioning, and recommend hedging or refinancing strategies as needed.
- Design and implement cash management processes and services; champion automation and TMS utilization to improve control and efficiency.
- Evaluate treasury products, services, and systems; recommend and implement fit-for-purpose solutions.
- Maintain strong internal controls, documentation, and policy compliance (including SOX, audit support, and regulatory requirements).
- Establish and track treasury KPIs and dashboards; communicate performance and opportunities to stakeholders.
- Lead and coach team members; promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration.
- Perform additional duties as assigned to support treasury and broader finance initiatives.

What You’ll Bring
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; CTP or CPA preferred.
- 8–10 years of progressive corporate treasury or finance experience, including cash management, liquidity, and bank relationship management.
- Hands-on experience with cash forecasting, working capital optimization, letters of credit/trade finance, and foreign exchange/hedging.
- Knowledge of interest rate risk, debt instruments, and short-term investments.
- Proficiency with Treasury Management Systems (TMS) and ERPs; strong Excel and analytical skills; familiarity with tools such as Kyriba, SAP, or Oracle is a plus.
- Proven leadership and team management experience; ability to influence cross-functionally and negotiate effectively.
- High attention to detail, confidentiality, and sound judgment; thrives in deadline-driven environments.

How You’ll Grow and Make an Impact
- Shape treasury strategy by advancing forecasting accuracy, strengthening bank partnerships, and improving cash returns.
- Reduce risk and cost of capital through disciplined FX and interest rate risk management.
- Lead process modernization and automation, elevating control and efficiency across global treasury operations.
- Gain exposure to senior finance leadership and cross-functional projects, creating opportunities to broaden scope and responsibility over time.

What We Offer
- A purpose-driven, inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued and collaboration is key.
- Professional development and learning opportunities to support continuous growth.
- Competitive total rewards, including comprehensive benefits and paid time off.
- Flexibility and support to do your best work while making a measurable impact.

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Shyft Global Services
Shyft Global Services is a leading technology lifecycle service provider that partners with companies around the world to shift the way they do business. Powered by a robust global logistics network, a team of outsourcing experts, and decades of experience, Shyft’s end-to-end product and customer lifecycle services enable technology companies to reinvest in growth, transformation, and innovation.

Shyft Global Services is a division of TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX).

About the Role
As a Senior Customer Program Manager, you will lead the post-award execution of complex customer programs for some of Shyft Global Services’ largest and most strategic accounts. You will serve as the primary customer contact and own the overall relationship, customer satisfaction, program profitability, contractual commitments, and service-level performance.
Working closely with Sales, the Global Project Management Office, and cross-functional business teams, you will translate contracts, master service agreements, statements of work, and financial models into scalable operational programs. You will establish governance, coordinate implementation, manage risks and escalations, and ensure that customer requirements become clear, actionable plans.

This is a visible, high-impact opportunity for an experienced program management professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges, influencing across teams, and helping global customers achieve meaningful outcomes. You will also have the opportunity to act as a strategic consultant, change leader, subject matter expert, and customer advocate.

What You’ll Do
- Serve as the primary day-to-day contact and trusted advisor for assigned customers.
- Lead program implementation and ongoing execution from post-award knowledge transfer through sustained delivery.
- Interpret and manage contractual obligations across master service agreements, statements of work, service-level agreements, and related program documentation.
- Own customer program financial management, including profitability tracking, forecasting, budgeting, and performance reporting.
- Monitor service-level agreements, key performance indicators, milestones, risks, and overall program health.
- Lead regular customer meetings, program reviews, and executive-level business presentations.
- Partner with customers and internal teams to define workflows, reporting requirements, governance processes, and information flows.
- Identify root causes, coordinate cross-functional issue resolution, and serve as the customer escalation point.
- Recognize out-of-scope requests and coordinate requirements for appropriate scoping, pricing, and change-order approval.
- Apply formal change-control processes when program scope, cost, budget, resources, or timelines are affected.
- Identify continuous-improvement and cost-saving opportunities that strengthen customer outcomes and program profitability.
- Maintain accurate program documentation, forecasts, business reviews, SLA reporting, and performance metrics.
- Build collaborative relationships across Sales, Finance, Legal, Operations, and other supporting functions.

What We’re Looking For
- 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in customer program management, project management, service delivery, account operations, or a related field.
- Demonstrated success managing complex customer programs, contracts, financial performance, and service-level commitments.
- Strong business and financial acumen, including forecasting, profitability analysis, and performance reporting.
- Ability to translate complex requirements into practical plans, priorities, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
- Advanced problem-solving, root-cause analysis, risk management, and decision-making skills.
